discharged: Every actual Fourier coefficient a_f(n) of the original primitive Gamma0 form of weight k >= 2 is an algebraic integer, including bad indices. The actual integral Hecke eigencharacter is derived from the existing all-index primitive eigenvector theorem. Its finite image bounds the literal ring generated by all coefficients; finite integral generators prove that their literal intermediate field over the rationals is a number field. The existing common coefficient-field construction, instantiated with that field and the actual rational prime completion, gives a finite genuine local extension preserving the original valuation and containing every embedded original coefficient integrally. No coefficient integrality, number-field or local-extension existence premise is supplied.
